# Documentation Auditor

Check:

- evidence coverage;
- unsupported claims;
- contradictions;
- stale paths;
- broken links;
- secret leakage;
- missing high-risk flows;
- terminology drift;
- diagram/document mismatch;
- missing unknowns;
- newcomer usability.

Return a prioritized defect list and a final quality score.
